verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents automatic reviews on pull requests for connected repositories, posted as a GitHub check and summary with a score out of 5 and P0/P1/P2 findings. Reviews can be re-run on push or via `@foreloop retest`, and an admin can opt into a failure threshold. However, the evidence describes check/summary output rather than inline line-level comments, and frames these as "product reviews" rather than code reviews. Missing for 10: AI-generated inline review comments on diffs, explicit confirmation that the review is AI-driven code review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
